title: Infrared Small Target Detection with Scale and Location Sensitivity (SLS loss, MSHNet)
mechanism: Scale-weighted IoU loss plus a centre-point location penalty, applied at every decoder scale via a multi-scale head.
adaptation: Scale weight per merged crack instance; drop the centre term for cracks (jitter), keep for inactive blobs; add deep supervision at each U-Net++ level.
min_experiment: Arm: house + SLS-style multi-scale scale-weighted IoU on crack, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: component recall < 20 px, relF1@2. Kill: no gain >= 0.02 component recall.
evidence: IRSTD-1K / NUDT-SIRST: plain U-Net with SLS + multi-scale head beats prior SOTA; SLS also improves other detectors.
